scientific_integrity: All claims are analytic under the stated finite-word assumptions; computations are checks, not an infinite proof. Self-review only; no independent validation or audit.
scientific_limitations: Independent identically distributed Bernoulli trials only. Run counts refer exclusively to maximal runs of ones. Marginal moments, the multivariate run-count machinery, and the leading n-order covariance are not claimed new. Equivalent finite covariance identities might be implicit in earlier multivariate run enumerations.
title: Finite-sample two-switch law for long-run counts in Bernoulli trials
